g.text: PRODUCTIVE · PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT · PART 1.1 · THE ENEMY OF PRODUCTIVITY
Every layer of the stack kills a specific enemy — you don't buy a tool, you diagnose which enemy is winning.
busyness wearing the costume of the real signal
does this even matter? → next action
background anxiety hum (Zeigarnik) — flat once caught
dropped commitment · shower idea · lost article ↓ gone
the cost is the long climb back to depth
it doesn't steal time, it steals depth
shield attenuates · only training stops it
filter so you never see most of it
on-board shield is not enough on its own ↓
▣ TRAIN · you can't tool your way out
Buy your way out of three.
Train your way out of distraction.
COMPANION TO PART 1.0 — THE SAME SIX LAYERS, ROTATED
1.0 stacked them to BUILD ↑ · 1.1 turns them sideways into the countermeasures that DEFEND the channel →
1.1 · DEFENDED CHANNEL → (what each layer is FOR)
EACH LAYER KILLS AN ENEMY — the table, now wired
focus app patched onto a memory leak —
it keeps leaking · output goes dead
Name the enemy first, then build — three you buy, distraction you train.
COGNITIVE = hardware · LEARNING = software · PRODUCTIVITY = the OS
Part 1.1 of 7 · Productivity Enhancement · the Productive pillar
